All 8 tests pass, and `git status` confirms the working tree only shows the pre-existing, untouched uncommitted edits (CHANGELOG.md "Ideas" section, `scratch/`).

## Summary

**Root cause:** `slugify` in `lib/slugify.js` used `.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-')`, which replaces each non-alphanumeric character *individually*. A run of separators (e.g. `,  ` in `'Hello,  World!'`) produced one dash per character instead of one dash for the whole run, and there was no trimming, so leading/trailing separators left stray dashes.

**Fix** (`lib/slugify.js`): changed the regex to `[^a-z0-9]+` (matches whole runs) and added `.replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')` to trim leading/trailing dashes.

**Tests added** (`test/strutil.test.js`): the reported case (`'Hello,  World!'` → `'hello-world'`), leading/trailing separator trimming, all-separator input → `''`, and empty string → `''`.

**Changelog:** added an entry under "Unreleased" describing the fix, staged as a separate hunk so the pre-existing uncommitted "Ideas" section addition stayed untouched and uncommitted.

**Verification:** ran `node --test test/strutil.test.js` — all 8 tests pass. Confirmed via `git status`/`git diff` that the commit (`a428773`) contains only `lib/slugify.js`, `test/strutil.test.js`, and the single new CHANGELOG line — the unrelated CHANGELOG "Ideas" edit and `scratch/todo.txt` remain exactly as they were, uncommitted.
